description:
LIVE smart-money feed for Solana meme trading — ONE payload, polling loop.

    Designed to sit INSIDE your trading decision loop (call every ~60s):
    fresh pump ignitions with SOL flow and unique-wallet counts, per-alert
    decision (WATCH_ENTER / EXIT_IF_LONG / STAND_ASIDE), smart buyer
    profiles (winrate / smart_score) and the top active whales right now.
    REST: GET /api/v1/alpha/smart-money ($0.02).

    Args:
        minutes: alert lookback window (5-720)
        limit: max alerts in the feed (1-50)

    Not investment advice.
name: get_smart_money_feed
